title: Decide whether a staff limit waiver also lowers a Space's network fee

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), pricing ladder review of #3284 (LIVE-822).

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: the payments gate lets a waived free Space sell at the Collective level, and the waiver migration says waived Spaces are treated as Collective, but spaceNetworkBps never reads spaceLimitsWaived. A waived free Space's network-sourced sales price at the free rung (10%), and a waived Business Space pays 5% instead of 3%. THE FIX if the owner says waivers include the fee: after the Collective inheritance step, when spaceLimitsWaived(spaceId), take min(rung(plan), rung(limitsWaivedPlan(plan))) so a Non Profit stays at 0%. If not, write that down in the waiver's help and close this row.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!/spaceLimitsWaived/.test(r('lib/billing/fees.ts'))){console.error('SCAN-835: the network fee ignores a staff waiver and no ruling says it should');process.exit(1)}"
